question: Where are a park located within a 140 kilometers radius to the west of Anvil Arts Studio, Newland, NC?
sql: SELECT park_name, leisure, tourism FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin( parks.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anvil Arts Studio%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Newland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 140 * 1000 -- 140 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anvil Arts Studio%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Newland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), ST_Centroid(parks.geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
